items.name: Regions and Availability Zones
items.explanation: A Region is a physical location where a cloud provider clusters data centres, and an Availability Zone is a group of data centres inside it with its own power and networking. Amazon's waves go Region by Region and zone by zone, so a failure stays in one zone first.

assumedBy.quote: Teams split regional deployments into even smaller-scoped deployments by deploying to individual Availability Zones

sources.title: Regions and Availability Zones (AWS Global Infrastructure)

items.name: Distributed tables in ClickHouse
items.explanation: ClickHouse spreads data over shards, and a Distributed table stores nothing itself but lets a query run across the underlying tables on many servers. Cloudflare's query read system.columns without filtering by database, so when an 11:05 grant made the underlying r0 tables' metadata visible too, the query returned duplicate rows.

assumedBy.quote: To query data from all shards, we have so-called distributed tables
